scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:packs && node --test "brain/test/*.test.ts" "packs/*/test/*.test.ts" "examples/pack/test/*.test.ts"
scripts.prompt-size: npm run build && npm run prompt-size --workspace brain
scripts.test:types: tsc -p brain/test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/pack/test/tsconfig.json && for t in packs/*/test/tsconfig.json; do [ -e "$t" ] || continue; tsc -p "$t"; done
